title: Reverse an Array
description: Reverse the elements of an array in place.

data.text: Given an array `arr`, reverse its elements.
Copy elements in reverse order into a new array. O(n) time, O(n) space.

data.title: Extra Array O(n)
data.content: Copy elements in reverse order into a new array.

data.text: Swap elements from both ends moving toward the center. O(n) time, O(1) space.

data.title: Two-Pointer In-Place O(n)
data.content: Swap elements from both ends moving toward the center.

data.title: What improved?
data.text: **Time:** O(n) both ways. **Space:** O(n) → O(1). The two-pointer approach modifies the array in-place with no extra memory.
